name: r5-l38-fade-door
description: ⛓ THE FADE PROBE, HALF TWO — the same forty-odd ticks with ONE DOOR in them. Boots into L38's NORTH room (which no walk can reach without the chest) and holds UP into `teleporter@144,0 -> L39`. 39 dead frames against the boot probe's 20 ⇒ this door costs NINETEEN, not the 20 `swimSoundClock.LOAD_DEAD_FRAMES` carries. Both halves together are what let `r5-totem-entrance`'s 370 be attributed: 39 of load and 331 of ceremony, which is `CEREMONY_DEAD_FRAMES.total` EXACTLY — 150 of `Pickup.specialTimer` and 181 of a `SealController` nobody had ever driven.
